title: Canadian Licensed Cannabis Store Counts by Province and City (from official registries), 2026-11-20
description: Aggregate counts of licensed, open retail cannabis stores in Canada: 4,030 stores across 13 provinces and territories and 1,027 cities, as of 2026-11-20. Compiled by Where's The Weed At (wherestheweedat.ca) from provincial and territorial registries and retailer lists. Contains aggregate counts only: no store names, addresses, licence numbers or personal data. Source registries keep their own terms; see the README.
